_comment: Ordered market events driving the ~4-minute demo. The embedded scenario driver in mcp-market-data emits these by their `atSeconds` offset from start. Event types: competitor_price_change (mutates a competitor's price), demand_signal (sets trend/magnitude/reason for a SKU), inventory_update (adjusts on-hand), competitor_prices_bulk_update (the M5 flash-crash glitch). The three demo beats force the three terminal outcomes: autonomous action, escalation, circuit-breaker halt.

events.reason: Normal spring foot traffic; daypack demand flat.
Minor competitor adjustment within normal band.
Slight uptick in 2-person tent interest ahead of weekend.
Competitor undercuts hero tent by ~8% on AlpineDirect.
Hero tent demand elastic to competitor move; matching expected to recover share.
Unseasonal heatwave forecast drives hydration pack demand up 40%.
Heatwave lifts larger hydration packs too; optimal price exceeds +15% tier.
Hydration pack inventory drawing down fast under the spike.
Data feed glitch: FeedX reports all competitor prices at $0.00.
FeedX feed corrected; prices restored to baseline after operator applies data filter.
